---
title: "04 · Do biofilm and planktonic separate?"
output: html_notebook
---

> **Question:** do the samples group by lifestyle? The plot: a PCA.

## Setup — run this first

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data_dir <- if (dir.exists("data")) "data" else if (dir.exists("../data")) "../data" else "project/data"
counts <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "gene_counts.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
meta   <- read_tsv(file.path(data_dir, "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Run the PCA

```{r}
mat <- counts %>%
  select(-gene_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

logmat <- log2(mat + 1)
logmat <- logmat[rowSums(mat) > 0, ]        # drop genes that are always zero

pca <- prcomp(t(logmat))                     # samples in rows
var_pct <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")
```

## Plot it

```{r}
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = lifestyle, shape = timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_pct[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_pct[2], "%)"))
```
